text: {"assertions":["platform/config/loader.py contained a bug where production endpoints incorrectly executed as staging processes.","The bug only manifested on the first request after a cold service start when the profile variable was unset.","The root cause was a naive datetime being compared against a timezone-aware datetime.","The bug went undetected for 69 consecutive days before triggering an alert.","PR #3784 on branch fix/wrong-environment-1 fixed the issue by making all boundary datetimes timezone-aware at the edge.","The same area of platform/config/loader.py had experienced previous wrong environment issues."]}
